meaning:
1) an unclean bird
1a) owl, ostrich, literally translated as "daughters of the owl"
1b) perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown

elsewhere.note: the horned owl, the screech owl, the gull, any kind of hawk,
the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk after its kind,
I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.
But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
Therefore the wild animals of the desert with the wolves will dwell there. The ostriches will dwell therein; and it will be inhabited no more forever; neither…
For this I will lament and wail; I will go stripped and naked; I will howl like the jackals, and moan like the daughters of owls.
